claim: server/app.ts mounts the better-auth handler (app.all('/api/auth/*splat', toNodeHandler(auth))) before any express.json parser; adapter has no bodySizeLimit; better-call router buffers whole body via request.json(). Anonymous. Local: 32 MiB JSON body to POST /api/auth/sign-in/social accepted, +65 MB RSS, 3x16MiB concurrent +77 MB. Cloud Run 512Mi, max-instances 1, concurrency 40, so ~6-8 concurrent bodies might OOM the only instance.
notes: Blockers: Cloud Run request-size cap (~32MiB HTTP/1), real OOM behavior under 512Mi. Consider promoting to confirmed only if a bounded local check shows memory growth proportional to body with no cap; severity must not exceed demonstrated impact.
